howItWorks.title: How DUJON works
howItWorks.intro: From creating a profile to connecting — five simple steps.

s1.title: Open an account
s1.body: Sign up with your name, email, date of birth and gender. Only people aged 18 or over can join. Your full name is never shown to others.

s2.title: Build your profile
s2.body: Add your education, occupation, area and a short introduction. A photo is optional, and you decide who can see it.

s3.title: Search by age and area
s3.body: Search published profiles by age range and division, district and upazila/thana. You only see members of the opposite gender.

s4.title: Express interest
s4.body: If you like a profile, express interest. The other member is notified by email, but your contact details stay private.

s5.title: Connect when you both agree
s5.body: When an interest is accepted, you can both see each other's email and mobile number, and talk directly.

note.title: Good to know
note.body: DUJON does not verify members' identity. Please read the safety tips before you make contact.

safetyPage.title: Safety and privacy
safetyPage.intro: Your safety matters to us. Here we say plainly what we do, what we don't, and how you can stay safe.

do.title: What we do
do.1: We block under-18s from registering, checked on the server.
do.2: Your mobile number and email are shown only to people you are mutually connected with.
do.3: We block phone numbers, emails and links in profile text.
do.4: You can block or report anyone. Once blocked, you can't see each other.
do.5: We strip all metadata, including location, from photos, and photos are never public — they are only served after an access check.

dont.title: What we don't do yet
dont.body: In this version we do not verify anyone's identity (such as NID), photos or information, and we do not label any profile "verified". Confirming an email is not identity verification. Members provide their own information, so don't assume everything is true.

tips.title: Tips before and after you meet
tips.1: Meet in a public place first and tell someone in your family.
tips.2: Never send money, whatever the reason — living abroad, a medical emergency or a gift.
tips.3: Never share OTPs, passwords or bank details.
tips.4: Talk over a video call first. Be careful if they avoid it.
tips.5: Stop if you feel rushed or pressured. Good relationships take time.

report.title: How to block and report
report.body: Open the menu (⋯) on any profile and choose "Block" or "Report". Our team reviews reports. If something feels wrong, don't wait.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: Please read these terms before using DUJON.

s1.title: Who we are
s1.body: DUJON is an online matrimony service for Bangladesh. The operating entity's name and address will be added here before launch.

s2.title: Eligibility
s2.body: You must be at least 18 and legally free to marry (never married, divorced or widowed). The service is intended for Bangladesh.

s3.title: Account responsibilities
s3.body: You are responsible for keeping your password secret and giving accurate information. Date of birth and gender cannot be changed after registration.

s4.title: Managed profiles
s4.body: Parents or guardians may manage a profile, but the person concerned must be 18+ and must agree.

s5.title: Acceptable use
s5.body: Harassment, scams, asking for money, false information, commercial use and putting contact details in profile text are not allowed.

s6.title: No identity verification
s6.body: In this version DUJON does not verify members' identity. Members are responsible for their own safety when contacting or meeting others.

s7.title: Interests and contact sharing
s7.body: When an interest is accepted, both members' email and mobile number become visible to each other.

s8.title: Content licence
s8.body: You give DUJON a limited licence to show your profile and photo to eligible members. Deleting the photo or your account ends it.

s9.title: Suspension and termination
s9.body: We may suspend or close accounts that break these rules.

s10.title: Disclaimers and limitation of liability
s10.body: DUJON is not responsible for the accuracy of information given by members. Detailed terms will be added after lawyer review.

s11.title: Changes to these terms
s11.body: If the terms change, we will publish a new version number.

s12.title: Governing law and contact
s12.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Bangladesh. For questions, see the contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How we collect, use and protect your information.

s1.title: Who is responsible for your data
s1.body: The data controller's name and contact details will be added here before launch.

s2.title: What we collect
s2.body: Account data (name, email, mobile), profile data (date of birth, education, occupation, area, introduction), an optional photo, records of interests, blocks and reports, and technical data needed for security. We do not collect NID, selfies or ID documents.

s3.title: Why we use it
s3.body: To run the service, show suitable profiles, keep it safe and prevent abuse, and send you necessary messages.

s4.title: Who can see what
s4.body: Visitors and search engines see no profiles. Logged-in members of the opposite gender see published profiles (without full name, date of birth, email or mobile). Only connected members see email and mobile.

s5.title: Service providers
s5.body: The list and locations of hosting, database, photo storage and email providers will be added here before launch.

s6.title: How long we keep it
s6.body: When you delete your account, your profile is hidden at once and personal data is permanently deleted within 30 days. Backups may take longer to clear.

s7.title: Your rights
s7.body: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data and withdraw consent. Tell us through the contact page.

s8.title: Security
s8.body: Passwords are stored with Argon2id, photos in private storage, and connections are encrypted.

s9.title: Cookies
s9.body: We use only essential cookies: your login session and language choice. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

s10.title: Children
s10.body: DUJON is not for people under 18. Report any profile that appears to be under 18.

s11.title: Changes and contact
s11.body: If this policy changes, we'll publish a new version. For questions, see the contact page.

guidelines.title: Community Guidelines
guidelines.intro: Please follow these rules to keep DUJON respectful and safe for everyone.

s1.title: Be truthful
s1.body: Give your real age, marital status and other details. Don't mislead.

s2.title: Be respectful
s2.body: No offensive, harassing or demeaning behaviour. "No" means no.

s3.title: Never ask for money
s3.body: Asking for money, gifts or financial help is not allowed. Report such requests.

s4.title: Use your own photo
s4.body: The photo should show only you. No explicit, violent or someone else's photos.

s5.title: Don't share contact details in public text
s5.body: Don't put phone numbers, emails or links in your profile. Details are shared automatically once you both agree.

s6.title: Respect others' privacy
s6.body: Don't share anyone's information or photos without permission.

s7.title: If rules are broken
s7.body: We may warn, hide a profile or suspend an account.
